description: Crown sitting on a continuous brim. One recipe; variants differ only in parameters.

parameter_doc.brim_root_y: frame row where the brim starts (seating anchor; vanilla Fishing/Straw = 9, Bucket = 10)
parameter_doc.crown_h: crown rows above the brim root
parameter_doc.crown_top_hw / crown_base_hw: crown half-width (incl. outline) at top / at base
parameter_doc.top_round: pixels removed per side on the top crown row (0 = flat-topped)
parameter_doc.base_flare: extra px per side on the last crown row (vanilla crown/brim junction flare)
parameter_doc.band_h: rows of band just above the brim root (0 = none)
parameter_doc.brim_kind: disc (ring seen from slightly above) | skirt (angled down all round)
parameter_doc.brim_hw: disc: front-view brim half-width (10 = full 20 px frame)
parameter_doc.lip_hw: disc: half-width of the front lip; outside it the brim hangs as lobes
parameter_doc.brim_droop / droop_power: disc: how far the lobes hang at the tips, and how late
parameter_doc.brim_far / brim_near: disc: ellipse rows - far edge shown above the root beside the crown / near edge dip at the centre
parameter_doc.brim_top_follow: disc: 0 = lobe top stays level (vanilla bowl), 1 = whole lobe bends down
parameter_doc.brim_curl: disc: px the right-hand brim (front view) flips up - soft/floppy brim; mirrored in back view
parameter_doc.skirt_rows / skirt_out / skirt_slope: skirt: rows, first-row overhang past the crown, extra px per row
parameter_doc.brim_stitch: skirt: row index of a stitched seam line (0 = none) - structural, region 'seam'
parameter_doc.side_*: right-view (left mirrors it): brim reach and droop back/front, crown extra depth, whole-view y shift
parameter_doc.back_rule / bowl_depth / bowl_power: bowl exception: brim seen from above-behind, near edge bowl_depth rows below the lip
parameter_doc.bowl_crown_extend: bowl back view: rows the crown continues down into the bowl

identity: short stiff brim angled DOWN all round (lampshade)
low soft crown with a band
deep bowl brim whose sides hang well below the lip
